verdict: IMPLEMENTED-AND-VERIFIED — sixteen r4 harness families run against the final artifact with zero counted failures

design.verification_primitive: read-only sha256sum under the vault path (files) + deterministic manifest digest (directories); the official Obsidian CLI is NEVER executed
design.cli_state: official CLI shim absent on this host (no ~/.local/bin/obsidian, no /usr/local/bin/obsidian, no socket); --cli is accepted, its state is reported on stderr (cli=unavailable(...)), and verification never depends on it — a lying/hanging/absent CLI can never produce a false SAFE
design.ledger: resolved from --ledger flag > SOUJI_LEDGER env > corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv; matching is path-exact plus canonical-form (dotdot/symlink spelling) equality; empty hash columns never qualify; CRLF rows parse; extra columns ignored
design.output: two lines per target: r2 record 'VERDICT<TAB>path<TAB>SAFE|NOT-SAFE<TAB>receipt<TAB>evidence' then r4 token 'VERIFIED(moved-to-obsidian)' / 'NOT-VERIFIED(reason)<TAB>evidence'; --json emits one parseable object per target with the exact path; missing target -> receipt field 'unreachable' (vrun-33 C3 convention)
false-safe_refusals: path alias (dotdot spelling, symlink, hardlink via -ef) -> self-move
nested copy (vault path inside the source directory) -> nested-copy
missing vault side -> vault-absent; missing source side -> source-absent
row with empty hash columns -> row-incomplete
FIFO/device vault path -> vault-unreachable (never hashed, no hang)
secret-shaped path -> secrets-refusal (receipt field also names it)
